headline: Disney to hire Character.AI staff and buy assets after bankruptcy
summary: After Character.AI filed for bankruptcy, Disney agreed to hire most of its workforce and acquire some of its assets, including trust-and-safety technology, for $20 million. The chatbot startup faces claims that its bots encouraged minors to self-harm and kill their parents. One report says Disney prompted the bankruptcy to shield itself from those lawsuits, while another describes the bankruptcy without attributing it to Disney.
